description: Wiring module for existing snow_connector.py into approval_workflow daemon. Phase 9 enterprise integration with numbered constraints: (1) MUST validate SNOW OAuth token freshness before each request; (2) MUST verify request signature using SNOW shared secret from keys file; (3) MUST reject unsigned webhooks with 401; (4) MUST write inbound tickets to mcp_submissions table via write_service :8772; (5) MUST NOT call write_service more than once per incoming webhook; (6) MUST implement 10s strict timeout on SNOW API calls. Reads snow_connector.py and approval_workflow.py from src/. Outputs integration_patch.py daemon that runs alongside existing snow_connector.py.
